description: Interface census of all 13 IFT-B subunits in 8BD7 to rank IFT56 as core scaffold versus peripheral subunit, plus contact-graph connectivity test
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import networkx as nx
os.makedirs('/tmp/ift',exist_ok=True)

cif=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8BD7.cif",timeout=300).text.split('\n')
st=next(i for i,l in enumerate(cif) if l.startswith('_atom_site.'))
hdr=[];i=st
while cif[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): hdr.append(cif[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
rows=[]
while i<len(cif) and not cif[i].startswith('#'):
    p=cif[i].split()
    if len(p)==len(hdr): rows.append(p)
    i+=1
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=hdr)
for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: at[c]=at[c].astype(float)
at['auth_seq_id']=at['auth_seq_id'].astype(int)

NAME={'A':'IFT88','B':'IFT52','C':'IFT70','D':'IFT46','E':'IFT56','F':'IFT81','G':'IFT74','I':'IFT80',
 'L':'IFT38','M':'IFT57','S':'IFT172','W':'IFT20','X':'IFT54',
 'H':'IFT88','J':'IFT52','K':'IFT70','N':'IFT46','O':'IFT56','P':'IFT81','Q':'IFT74','R':'IFT80',
 'T':'IFT38','U':'IFT57','V':'IFT172','Y':'IFT20','Z':'IFT54'}
SUB={'IFT88':'B1','IFT52':'B1','IFT70':'B1','IFT46':'B1','IFT56':'B1','IFT81':'B1','IFT74':'B1',
     'IFT80':'B2','IFT38':'B2','IFT57':'B2','IFT172':'B2','IFT20':'B2','IFT54':'B2'}
REP={c:(1 if c in list('ABCDEFGILMSWX') else 2) for c in NAME}
chains=[c for c in NAME if c in set(at.auth_asym_id)]
coords={c:at[at.auth_asym_id==c][['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values for c in chains}
resid={c:at[at.auth_asym_id==c]['auth_seq_id'].values for c in chains}
nres={c:len(np.unique(resid[c])) for c in chains}
trees={c:cKDTree(coords[c]) for c in chains}

CUT=5.0
rec=[]
for a in chains:
    for b in chains:
        if a>=b: continue
        pr=trees[a].query_ball_tree(trees[b],CUT)
        ra=set();rb=set()
        for k,lst in enumerate(pr):
            if lst:
                ra.add(int(resid[a][k]))
                for x in lst: rb.add(int(resid[b][x]))
        if ra:
            rec.append({'cA':a,'cB':b,'A':NAME[a],'B':NAME[b],'repA':REP[a],'repB':REP[b],
                        'nA':len(ra),'nB':len(rb),'ncontacts':len(ra)+len(rb),
                        'lateral':REP[a]!=REP[b]})
E=pd.DataFrame(rec)
E.to_csv('/tmp/ift/8BD7_all_interfaces.csv',index=False)

# subunit-level census using repeat-1 chains as query (count partners in either repeat)
q1=[c for c in chains if REP[c]==1]
cen=[]
for c in q1:
    sel=E[(E.cA==c)|(E.cB==c)]
    intra=sel[~sel.lateral]; lat=sel[sel.lateral]
    nint=sum(r['nA'] if r['cA']==c else r['nB'] for _,r in intra.iterrows())
    nlat=sum(r['nA'] if r['cA']==c else r['nB'] for _,r in lat.iterrows())
    partners=sorted({(r['B'] if r['cA']==c else r['A']) for _,r in intra.iterrows()})
    latpart=sorted({(r['B'] if r['cA']==c else r['A']) for _,r in lat.iterrows()})
    cen.append({'subunit':NAME[c],'subcomplex':SUB[NAME[c]],'len_modelled':nres[c],
                'n_intra_partners':len(partners),'intra_iface_res':nint,
                'iface_res_per_100aa':round(100*nint/nres[c],1),
                'n_lateral_partners':len(latpart),'lateral_iface_res':nlat,
                'intra_partners':','.join(partners),'lateral_partners':','.join(latpart)})
C=pd.DataFrame(cen).sort_values('intra_iface_res',ascending=False)
print("=== Per-subunit interface census in 8BD7 (heavy-atom < 5 A), repeat-1 chains ===")
print(C.to_string(index=False))
C.to_csv('/tmp/ift/8BD7_subunit_census.csv',index=False)

r=C.set_index('subunit')
print("\nIFT56 rank by buried partner count:", list(C.subunit).index('IFT56')+1, "of", len(C))
print("IFT56 interface residues:", int(r.loc['IFT56','intra_iface_res']),
      "| median across 13 subunits:", int(C.intra_iface_res.median()),
      "| B1 median:", int(C[C.subcomplex=='B1'].intra_iface_res.median()))

# ---- graph connectivity: is IFT56 an articulation point? ----
G=nx.Graph()
for _,x in E[~E.lateral & (E.repA==1)].iterrows(): G.add_edge(x['A'],x['B'],w=x['ncontacts'])
print("\nIFT-B repeat-1 contact graph: nodes",G.number_of_nodes(),"edges",G.number_of_edges())
print("articulation points:",sorted(nx.articulation_points(G)))
bc=nx.betweenness_centrality(G)
deg=dict(G.degree())
print("degree / betweenness:")
for n in sorted(deg,key=lambda x:-deg[x]):
    print(f"  {n:7s} deg={deg[n]}  betweenness={bc[n]:.3f}")
G2=G.copy(); G2.remove_node('IFT56')
print("remove IFT56 -> connected:",nx.is_connected(G2),"components:",nx.number_connected_components(G2))

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.5))
ax=axes[0]
cc=C.sort_values('intra_iface_res')
colors=['#4C78A8' if s=='B1' else '#B0B7C3' for s in cc.subcomplex]
bars=ax.barh(cc.subunit,cc.intra_iface_res,color=colors)
for b,s in zip(bars,cc.subunit):
    if s=='IFT56': b.set_color('#E45756')
ax.set_xlabel('Interface residues buried within the IFT-B repeat (heavy atom < 5 A)')
ax.set_title('IFT56 has the smallest intra-repeat interface of all 13\nmodelled IFT-B subunits (PDB 8BD7)')
ax.text(0.98,0.05,'red: IFT56   blue: IFT-B1   grey: IFT-B2',transform=ax.transAxes,ha='right',fontsize=8)

ax=axes[1]
cc2=C.sort_values('n_intra_partners')
colors=['#4C78A8' if s=='B1' else '#B0B7C3' for s in cc2.subcomplex]
bars=ax.barh(cc2.subunit,cc2.n_intra_partners,color=colors)
for b,s in zip(bars,cc2.subunit):
    if s=='IFT56': b.set_color('#E45756')
ax.set_xlabel('Number of direct partners within the repeat')
ax.set_title('IFT56 contacts three subunits: IFT46, IFT70, IFT52')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals()['CENSUS']=C; globals()['EDGES']=E
